fld_description: Cruise designation (YYYYMM) -- passed to resolve_cruise_key() as the source's own designation.
notes: 24 distinct; one designation can hold two ships (e.g. 200501 JD and NH)

fld_description: Ship name.
notes: asserted equal to the ship reference's ship_name for the same ship_key

fld_description: Two-letter ship code; equals the ship reference's ship_key (NH, SP, JD, FR, OD, MF, SH, OS).
notes: asserted in Resolve Ship and Cruise Keys

fld_description: Order in which the station was occupied on the cruise; part of the cast key.
Cast latitude in decimal degrees (WGS84).
Cast longitude in decimal degrees (WGS84; west negative).
CalCOFI line number (extended numbering north of the grid).
notes: -14.0 to 95.3; negative north of the grid (35 casts get no site_key)

fld_description: CalCOFI station number.
CTD start time (UTC).
Standard depth of the value.
CTD temperature.
notes: pivoted to measurement_type='temperature_1'; on every row; 0.15-20.6 degC

fld_description: CTD salinity, mostly not calibrated against bottle samples.
notes: pivoted to measurement_type='salinity_1'; on every row; 0.48-35.27 (Q02)

fld_description: CTD dissolved oxygen, mostly not calibrated against bottle samples.
notes: pivoted to measurement_type='oxygen_ml_l_1'; NaN on 4,475 rows (not published); 0.05-14.87 ml/L (Q02)

fld_description: Oxygen saturation. Not published (Q05).
Integer pivot FK between ctd_cast and ctd_measurement (not the published key; see sample_key_id).
Natural cast key: cruise-ship_code-order_occupied (asserted unique); the id part of sample_key swfsc_ctd-noaa:cast:{id}.
notes: derived from the source's own columns

fld_description: CalCOFI station key in 'LLL.L SSS.S' form; NULL for a negative line or station.
notes: derived from line + station via normalize_site_key()

fld_description: Shallowest standard depth of the cast.
Deepest standard depth of the cast.
Natural cruise key YYYY-MM-NODC; resolved via resolve_cruise_key().
notes: see Resolve Ship and Cruise Keys

fld_description: Sequential measurement identifier; primary key of ctd_measurement.
FK to ctd_cast.cast_id.
FK to measurement_type.measurement_type (temperature_1, salinity_1, oxygen_ml_l_1).
Numeric value of the measurement; units carried by measurement_type.
